scope: Read-only review of current store candidate plus three focused independent fixtures; no formal performance or fresh quality acceptance.

findings.conclusion: One SELECT binds stored source hash, inherited project/chapter names, created_at, actual counts and revision to one SQLite snapshot. The computed hash includes normalized source, pagination settings and INDEX_VERSION. Valid exact replays make no writes.

A preflight miss enters the preserved BEGIN IMMEDIATE path and re-reads session, metadata and hash. Focused test inserts the same desired request through the original transaction after the miss; replay returns skipped with revision 2 and does not duplicate data.

Six sequential operations (chapter move, omitted inherited names/date, equivalent +08:00 timestamp, explicit names) match the original transaction on complete ingest response, exported source and SQL dump.

Route IDs are unique by pages.id. Identical route sequences retain exactly the former order and exact-route rank values. Fusion arithmetic and directory weighting retain original operation order. Independent SQL/formula fixture verifies float.hex() values for both identical and genuinely fused routes.

A matching read can return its coherent committed snapshot while another writer later commits. This is a legitimate read linearization point; do not promise observation-for-observation equivalence with the old COMMIT-then-separate-revision-read under concurrent writers.

limits: Timing is not reviewed or accepted by these correctness fixtures.
The stored content hash/count shortcut assumes a valid archive written through supported ingestion; arbitrary out-of-band corruption or forged hashes are not repaired by an unchanged ingest.
Existing compatible writer/index-trigger policy is retained, not reimplemented.
